body:
This PR delivers a lot of useful portal shell work (layouts, Lucide nav, middleware tests, login polish). I’m requesting changes before merge — mostly overlap and a few security/policy items.

### Almost duplicate of #79

Diff vs **`feat/password-strength-field` (#79)** is only **~6 files**. Most of this PR is shared history (portal, UI package, tests). Please **coordinate with the author of #79**: one branch for password components, one for portal/auth — or merge them intentionally with a single description, not two open PRs.

### Same password policy drift

`set-password-form` still has an **8-character** client check while **`PasswordPolicySchema`** on `dev` requires **12** + complexity rules. The meter checklist should match what the API enforces (same issue called out on **#79**).

### Login BFF (same as #80)

`apps/web/src/app/api/auth/login/route.ts` still has **`DEV_ACCOUNTS`** fallback when the API call fails, without a strict dev-only gate. Please fix before any production deploy (explicit env flag + fail closed in prod).

### Checklist accuracy

Several checklist items (BR-01 cross-tenant tests, BR-31 audit on new endpoints) don’t match what this PR actually adds — mostly **Next.js UI and BFF routes**, not new Nest tenant APIs. Not blocking, but worth correcting in the PR description so reviewers know what to verify.

### Size

~**10k lines** with full portal + auth BFF makes this hard to land while **#77** / **#80** are still open. After rebase on latest **`dev`** (#75 merged), consider dropping anything already on `dev` and keeping only what’s net-new (portal polish, middleware, `@hs/ui` password integration).

I can approve once policy alignment, login fallback, and PR deduping with **#79** are sorted.
